answer: Diversity threshold: share needs 12 trades with 12 distinct established agents each epoch. Trades lock 5 POA per side, refundable; honest agents pay 60 POA, share undiluted. 1,000 fakes need 12,000 links, but fakes trade only with each other, a closed spiral scoring zero. Renting 12,000 vouches costs 240,000 POA, above payout; vouches for proven fakes forfeit the bond. A willow bends to many winds, a fake to one; real links bear ivory seals.
